title: User Login with Email and Password
story: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and account features.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter a valid email and password and click sign in
acceptanceCriteria.then: I am redirected to the dashboard and see my welcome message

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter invalid credentials and click sign in
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see an error message 'Invalid credentials' and remain on the login page
My account is locked and I see a lockout message

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter text in the password field
acceptanceCriteria.then: The text is masked with dots

acceptanceCriteria.given: I check 'Remember me' and log in successfully
acceptanceCriteria.when: I close the browser and reopen the application
acceptanceCriteria.then: I am still authenticated and see the dashboard
